sentences.text: Shri Yogesh Purohit - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Rajesh Joshi G.A appearing on behalf of Advocate   ORDER This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 12.05.2015 in Sessions Case No.155/14 by the Additional Session Judge, Dhar whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2)(i)
of the IPC and has respectively been sentenced to undergo 4 years R.I.; 5 years' R.I.; and 10 years R.I. and to pay fine of Rs.1,000/-, 1500/- and 5,000/- with usual default stipulation.
2.

This appeal arises out of the incident dated 26.05.2014 in which accused committed rape with the prosecutrix on the pretext of marriage and regarding which a Crime No.372/2014 was registered at Police Station Kukshi, District Dhar.

3. The PUD No.901/Warrant/2025 dated 20.05.2025 of Superintendent, Central Jail, Barwani mentions that the appellant/accused NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21605 2 CRA-1574-2016 has been released on 08.03.2022 after completing the sentence and depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
